description: Run an axe-core scan against a URL or HTML file and return the violations as findings.

exclude.description: CSS selectors to exclude from scan

include.description: CSS selectors to include in scan

tags.description: axe-core tags to filter by (default: ["wcag2a", "wcag2aa", "wcag21a", "wcag21aa", "wcag22aa"], every WCAG 2.2 A and AA rule)

name: run_axe_scan

component.description: Component or template, when the defect repeats.

evidence.description: The offending markup, value or measurement.

location.description: Where the defect is, precisely enough to open.

notes.description: Anything a person must decide, and anything that could not be checked.

passed.description: Checks that ran and found nothing, so 'clean' is distinguishable from 'not checked'.

title: Run axe-core Accessibility Scan
